scope: Proposition 11.4 (Crepant gdlt modification) of the manuscript “Finite ordinary minimal model programs on compact Kähler fourfolds” (preprints/Finite-ordinary-minimal-model-programs-on-compact-Kahler-fourfolds-October-6-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 056 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b1b9511572d6c717), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 76. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let (V, A + M) be a rational glc pair of dimension at most four on a normal compact Kähler space. Its higher nef line data are carried by a projective modification, and KV + A + MV is a rational holomorphic line bundle. There is a projective bimeromorphic morphism h : Y → V such that Y is normal compact Kähler and globally strongly Q-factorial, (Y, AY + M) is gdlt with AY ≥ 0, and KY + AY + MY = h∗ (KV + A + MV ). Every h-exceptional prime has coefficient one in AY , or equivalently has generalized log discrepancy zero over (V, A + M). Global strong Q-factoriality is not assumed for V .
